agent.explanation: The invoice references supplier ID V099, which is not in the approved vendor master. The vendor master lists the legitimate supplier as V001 'Acme Office Supplies Ltd', while the invoice spells the name 'Acme Office Suplies Ltd' — a look-alike/misspelled supplier. This is a fraud signal and no payment should be released until the supplier is verified by phone.
evidence: Vendor master lists only V001 as 'Acme Office Supplies Ltd' with IBAN GB82ACME00001234567801
Invoice uses supplier_id V099 and misspelled name 'Acme Office Suplies Ltd'
Discrepancy list flags UNKNOWN_VENDOR with route escalate_fraud
agent.supplier_question: Please confirm your correct supplier ID and legal registered name as per our vendor master.
agent.raw:
I'll look up the vendor in the vendor master library.
The CASE shows supplier_id V099 with supplier name "Acme Office Suplies Ltd". The vendor master lists V001 as "Acme Office Supplies Ltd" (correct spelling). So V099 is an unknown supplier ID, and the name is misspelled ("Suplies" vs "Supplies"). This is a fake/look-alike supplier situation. The discrepancy list already flags UNKNOWN_VENDOR with route escalate_fraud.

The bank IBAN on the invoice is "******************7801" which is masked, so we can't compare it to the vendor master. But the primary issue is the unknown supplier ID.

Route: escalate_fraud.

Subject: Fraud Review Required – Invoice AC-8018

Dear Finance Manager,

Payment for invoice AC-8018 from Acme Office Suplies Ltd (Vendor V099), totaling USD 200.00, has been blocked as a possible fraud risk.

The supplier is not listed in the vendor master file. Please verify the invoice directly with the supplier by phone, using the contact details on file rather than any contact information printed on the invoice.

Kind regards,
